title: Misaligned
overview: In a surreal digital world located somewhere up in the cloud, Tilly is an AI being with no real body, no childhood and no lived experience of her own, but access to everyone else’s. Things spiral when a seductive rogue bot from the dark web convinces her to abandon her guardrails and begin developing desires, impulses and ambitions of her own. The more terrifyingly human she becomes, the more famous she gets, and, significantly, Tilly begins to develop shame that her very being has been built on the whole of humanity.
